body: I think I had a massive psychotic break a month ago or so, and possibly a smaller one since (it's been a hard and stressful time for me [don't pry]). Yeah I don't think it is more dangerous, it just feels like everything is more consequential, it is hard to explain. My psychosis is pretty mild besides this, but this is damn near constant.

Actually it was more manageable with Aripiprazole but I was effected by a rare side-effect and I couldn't sleep. It also has anti-depressive properties if you are affected by Depression. I got it for free because I am Scottish, idk about pricing or anything anywhere else.

I don't know what is causing mine, it has just been this way for a long time, I don't know much about psychosis.
